rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING PUBLIC BASIC EDUCATION SCHOOLS IN GEOGRAPHICALLY ISOLATED AND DISADVANTAGED AND CONFLICT-AFFECTED AREAS, PROVIDING ACCESS ROADS LEADING TO LAST MILE SCHOOLS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Last Mile Schools Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to improve the quality and access to basic education of children in the far-flung, isolated, disadvantaged and conflict-affected areas, as well as those in Last Mile Schools, by investing on school infrastructures and roads leading to the said public schools.
Defines Last Mile Schools as “public basic education schools with gaps in resources and facilities which are located in geographically isolated and disadvantaged and conflict-affected areas (GIDCA).”
Provides the criteria in identifying a public school to be included among the Last Mile Schools.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2024-09-19, transmitted to the Senate on 2024-09-23 and received by the Senate on 2024-09-23

rows.title_short: Young Farmers And Fisherfolk Challenge Act
rows.abstract:
Aims to ensure that the rights of the young farmers and fisherfolks are recognized, protected and promoted by involving the youth in nation building and rural development and providing them access to knowledge, information and education, land, new sources of financial services and capital, green jobs and participation in policy dialogue.
Establishes the Young Farmers and Fisherfolk Challenge Program that shall support and empower the young farmers to be active partners in food security and agricultural development and modernization.

rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE PHILIPPINE COAST GUARD BY INTRODUCING POLICY AND ORGANIZATIONAL REFORMS
rows.title_short: Revised Philippine Coast Guard Law
rows.abstract:
Seeks to further strengthen the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) as an institution in addressing the ever changing and challenging mandate to ensure the maritime safety and security of the country.
Mandates that the PCG shall continue to be attached to the Department of Transportation (DOTr) provided that in times of war, as declared by Congress, the PCG or parts thereof, shall be attached to the Department of National Defense (DND).
Provides the uniformed personnel of the PCG to receive the same base pay, hazard pay, and other benefits and allowances corresponding to the salary grades and ranks in the AFP while the salaries and allowances of the non-uniformed personnel shall be in accordance with the existing CSC laws, rules and regulations, among others.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING BETTER SERVICES TO MUSLIM FILIPINO PILGRIMS THROUGH PRIVATIZATION OF THE ANNUAL HAJJ PILGRIMAGE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9997, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE “NATIONAL COMMISSION ON MUSLIM FILIPINOS ACT OF 2009”
rows.title_short: Providing Better Services To Muslim Filipino Pilgrims Through Privatization Of The Annual Hajj Pilgrimage, Amending For The Purpose Republic Act No. 9997, Otherwise Known As The " National Commission On Muslim Filipinos Act Of 2009 "
rows.abstract:
Provides that the National Commission on Muslim Filipinos (NCMF) shall represent the Philippine delegation and sign government to government agreements for the purpose of the Annual Hajj.
Mandates the Bureau of Pilgrimage and Endowment (BPE) to ensure a successful annual Muslim pilgrimage to Mecca, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia by coordinating with the pertinent offices, monitor the booking of travel arrangements, such as flights and hotels, and processing of the pilgrim´s travel documents.
Prohibits the BPE from the participation in the Administration of the Annual Hajj including the collection of fees, booking of hotels, procurement of foods, materials and supplies, arrangement of flights to and from the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, or processing of visas.
Gives the pilgrims the free choice of travel agencies, service providers and airlines for the Annual Hajj in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
Provides the BPE to accredit qualified and deserving sheiks/Hajj operators who are private individuals or entities that engages in facilitating, processing, and providing guidance to Muslim Filipinos for the annual Hajj.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2024-11-12, transmitted to the Senate on 2024-11-13 and received by the Senate on 2024-11-13

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE SELECTION OF AN ACTING PRESIDENT AND ACTING VICE PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.title_short: “ Caretaker President And Vice President Act ”
rows.abstract: Provides the manner for the selection of an Acting President and Acting Vice President and seeks to address the scenarios where there is a failure of elections for the Presidency and Vice Presidency or where both offices become vacant due to death or permanent disability and the President of the Senate, or the Speaker of the House of Representatives fail to act as President.

rows.abstract: Proposes the following amendments: Â transfer of the jurisdiction over vapes, heated tobacco products (HTPs) from the DTI to the Food and Drug Administration; prohibition of its online marketing and distribution; and provides that the age when it can be accessed be increased to twenty-one (21) years old - to make it congruent with the Sin Tax Reform Act.

rows.author: K034;
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL TUTORING PROGRAM
rows.abstract:
Seeks to establish a learning intervention to improve the literacy and numeracy rates among our elementary students (giving priority to those who belong to the marginalized and underserved communities); and to provide short-term employment and educational opportunities for financially struggling college students.
Aims to address the below baseline level of proficiency in mathematics and the very low passing rate in the expected minimum reading standards for primary learners.
Provides that tertiary level students qualified as tutors shall receive stipend and academic credit or other educational benefits as determined by their respective institutions.
Proposes that tutors under this Program for two (2) semesters shall be deemed to have completed the Literacy Training Service under the National Service Training Program (R.A. No.9163).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2024-09-16

rows.author: I018;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE MANDATORY INSTALLATION OF GPS TRACKING DEVICE IN ALL GOVERNMENT OWNED VEHICLES IN THE COUNTRY TO PROMOTE TRANSPARENCY, TO AID ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE AND TO PROTECT CITIZENS AND PUBLIC OFFICERS ALIKE AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Defines term "Global Positioning System (GPS)" to a space-based satellite navigation system that provides location and time information under all weather conditions, anywhere on or near the Earth where there is an unobstructed line of sight to four or more GPS satellites. Mandates the installation of GPS tracking devices to enable government agencies, institutions, and subdivisions to detect, monitor, and investigate the real-time movements of government-owned vehicles. This ensures that these vehicles are used for their legally designated purposes. Additionally, the GPS system aims to assist public officers in responding promptly to deter criminal activity, respond to emergencies, and aid in investigations. It also generates audit trails that expedite legal proceedings, alleviate congestion in court dockets, and support law enforcement in various interactions.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2024-09-16
